Before the edge, on white: tab (a tab label, sans 16, one line) and gap (a two-word line in the display face, 72px / 40px, one line). On the full lime screen: h2a + h2b (two-tone H2, 64px / 40px; one line each at 1440; at 390 one line up to about 20 characters, two at the budget), sub (sans 20 / 17, two lines at 1440, three at 390), and one row of three unequal cards (1fr 2fr 1fr; one card per row on tablets and phones), a Session between turns in this order: the sandbox (what goes), the working directory with the conversation (what stays: the wide middle card), the Session ID (what does not change). Each label is a change of state, "<thing>: <state>" (zh / ja with a full-width colon), not a part's name: the five parts are the spec table's rows. Label 16 w500, one line; line 15, at most two lines, balanced (accent.css): write each line as two phrases of about the same length, and join with a no-break space (\u00a0) what must not be split across lines (Session ID, Git state, Live processes end; ja: the particle after a Latin word). Say exactly what comes back: attachments never enter a checkpoint (staging v5/FIXES.md row 10), so the cards name the working directory and the conversation, never the uploaded files. Do not add another "days later": the hero, the stage, the spec table, the gap line and the FAQ already say it. Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs (en characters, zh / ja full-width widths). Sources: $source below; the tab, gap, H2 and sub: staging v5/content/NOTES.md. The zh and ja cards (2026-10-20 polish) still need a native speaker's review.

$source.h2: v4b's line. The sandbox is reclaimed once idle (docs/prd/session-lifecycle.md L8); the Session has no inactivity deadline (SPEC §4 L60) and continues after the sandbox was reclaimed (SPEC §4 L53).
$source.sub: A turn succeeds only when a checkpoint of its workspace and native conversation commits with it, and failed or cancelled turns never replace the last one (SPEC §4 L46, L49); the next input restores it, on a fresh sandbox once the old one was reclaimed (session-lifecycle.md L8).
$source.cards: Main repo excellent-frost-5baed21b at 8faf66a79a. Card 1, Sandbox: reclaimed / When idle. Live processes end with it.: a sandbox left idle for SESSION_RUNTIME_IDLE_GRACE_MS is reclaimed automatically (docs/prd/session-lifecycle.md L8; 5 min, apps/api/src/modules/runtime/domain/session-runtime-policy.ts L2), never before the turn's checkpoint commits (docs/SPEC.md L47); live processes, sockets and machine-wide temporary state are never carried over (SPEC L54). Card 2, Working directory: kept / Git state, dependencies, and the conversation.: cold continuation exposes the same state as warm, the working directory including files outside outputs/, Git state and dependencies installed inside it, and the harness's native conversation (SPEC L53; README.md L26: keeps the working directory and the native conversation between turns; docs/prd/session-files.md L9). Attachments are mounted read-only from file storage and never enter a checkpoint (SPEC L54; session-files.md L16), so no card says the uploaded files come back. Card 3, Session ID: unchanged / On a fresh sandbox, never an empty Session.: the handle is one durable ID, thread.id (SPEC L38), and follow-up input uses the same handle (SPEC L72; acceptance: a follow-up after forced reclamation continues the same Session ID, SPEC L82); the next input restores the last committed native conversation on a fresh sandbox (session-lifecycle.md L8); a missing or unrestorable checkpoint fails the continuation explicitly: mosoo never opens an empty workspace or conversation in its place and never substitutes a new Session (SPEC L56). zh / ja say the same: zh 3 "绝不会是空的 Session" and ja 3 "中身は空になりません" are SPEC L56.

en.sub: Every successful turn ends in a checkpoint. The next turn resumes from there.
